# Change contract
- [ ] Domain owner and source of truth identified; no duplicate ELYORA engine or BUILD-23 baseline
- [ ] Changes reviewed against ADRs and contract schemas
- [ ] Tenant/resource/role/field/timebox and negative authorization tests added
- [ ] Teacher/Student private data and management projections isolated
- [ ] Events durable/typed, idempotency and rollback considered
- [ ] npm run check locally and CI evidence attached
- [ ] Connected staging/production statuses only if actual connected logs exist
- [ ] New risk, migration, agent/quality findings and release evidence recorded
